name: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd
title: Pyramid Technoplast Ltd - 543969 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity up 22% to 76,931 MTPA with utilisation at ~69% and capex falling to ~20 crore in FY27; Q4 EBITDA up 68% to 20 crore, but margin gains are partly inventory-driven and utilisation remains well below 80%.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter improved to around 69%, and we expect this to gradually move closer to 80% in the next financial year.

capex.quote: we expect only around 20 crore of maintenance and balance CAPEX during financial year 27
